subject: Mobile Development
title: Desktop vs. Mobile Operating Systems
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Desktop vs. Mobile Operating Systems.

hook.text: Windows runs on a laptop plugged into a wall. Mobile OSes must survive on a tiny battery.

buildup.text: Mobile OSes aggressively suspend apps, dim screens, and throttle processors to save power.

discovery.text: Touch input replaces keyboard and mouse. The entire UI paradigm changes.

twist.text: Modern phones have more RAM and processing power than most 2010-era desktop computers.

climax.text: Mobile OSes aren't weaker — they're optimized for different constraints than desktops.

quiz.question: Why do mobile OSes aggressively suspend apps?
